notes: Proton is now also found through the Windows uninstall registry, so a future install-layout change can't lose it.
patch_notes: If a future Proton update moves its install folder, GameMode still finds it: the Proton search now falls back to the Add/Remove Programs registry entry (InstallLocation, DisplayIcon, or UninstallString) when the usual folders come up empty. Only entries actually named Proton VPN count, and a path is only used when the exe file really exists there - a missing or broken registry entry just means 'not found', never a guess. Covered by new test round 25.
